# $crav1-fix-bug

lane: cross-cutting | group: Start | starter: yes | stage: stable | since: 1.7.0 | prompts: 2
purpose: Name one real bug the user already named.
use_when: The user names a real bug
reads: Reads only the bug the user named and a spec already in front of them.
writes: Writes nothing.
leaves alone: Leaves code, specs, plans, `verify.md`, and `work-item.md` alone.
limits: no bug named, or not a real bug, stops with no lane. Spark, specify, plan, and verify do not run it. When the bug changes how the parts connect, it asks once whether to run `$crav1-refresh-system-notes` and does not run it.
flow:
- When a real bug is named, **`$crav1-fix-bug`** says where it was seen, names the bug, points at the spec or the shipped behavior it breaks, and names the lane.
- The rule is `docs/reference/open-skill-file.md`.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: The lane it names (Specify, Plan, or Build)
first: `$crav1-fix-bug Bug: <what is wrong> Seen: <verify | a report | production> Name the lane. Do not edit code. Do not open a pull request.`
walkthrough: from-fix-bug.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.209.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-fix-bug.md
